title: Synthesis of azulenyl-substituted gold(I)-carbene complexes and investigation of their anticancer activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41260-41269
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07020A, Paper
Open Access

Martin C. Dietl, Christopher Hüßler, Matthias Scherr, Zoé M. Frederiksen, Jürgen Graf, Frank Rominger, Matthias Rudolph, Isabella Caligiuri, Laura Tripodi, Flavio Rizzolio, Thomas Scattolin, A. Stephen K. Hashmi
The direct and atom economic synthesis of azulenyl-substituted gold(I) carbene complexes, based on the modular template synthesis using gold(I) isonitrile complexes and amine nucleophiles, is presented.
